relationships.subject: Rac1-PAK1 pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: A growing body of evidence implicates dysregulation of the Rac1-PAK1 signaling pathway in driving these changes

key_findings: After SCI, dendritic spine density, redistribution and head enlargement correlate with pain and spasticity.
Pharmacologic inhibition of Rac1-PAK1 reverses spine dysgenesis and reduces hyperexcitability in preclinical models.
